The objectives of this notebook will be to conduct a cluster analysis using site-averaged BLM predictor variables to identify a typological classification of samples. This classification will be balled Typology2

This will be conducted under the baseline BLM assumptions (HA 10% Closed System) within the Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet Clean version 2.

First, set the working directory

```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/calbert/OneDrive - IRTA/Escriptori/Trace-element-bioavailability-spatial-assessment/Zinc/5. Cluster analysis")
```

# Identifying Stream Typologies

Using Site average values of BLM predictors.

Import dataset

```{r}
library(readxl)

dat <- read_excel("C:/Users/calbert/OneDrive - IRTA/Escriptori/Trace-element-bioavailability-spatial-assessment/Zinc/4. Exploratory data analysis/Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet_Clean2.xlsx", 
                  sheet = "HA 10% Closed System")

head(dat)
```

Omit pooled samples

```{r}
library(dplyr)

flowing_dat <- dat %>%
  filter(Flow_state != "Pooled")

# Check
unique(flowing_dat$Flow_state)
```

## 1. Select variables by site

We'll use the scaled, log-transformed BLM predictors to conduct a PCA

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(cluster)

# Variables to select
vars_to_select <- c("log_Temp_C", "pH", "log_DOC_uM",
                    "log_DIC_uM", "log_Cl_uM", "log_Ca_uM", 
                    "log_Mg_uM", "log_SO4_uM", "log_Na_uM", 
                    "log_K_uM", "log_Zn_uM", "log_Cu_uM")

# Scale sample-level chemistry variables
scaled_blm_predict <- as.data.frame(
  scale(flowing_dat[vars_to_select])
)

# Add Site back in
scaled_blm_predict$Site <- flowing_dat$Site

# Average scaled values by Site
site_means_scaled <- scaled_blm_predict %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(vars_to_select), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


```

## 2. K-means clustering

### i. Identifying the number of clusters

Run k-means using 2-5 and identify which number of clusters minimizes the overlap

```{r}
# Create numeric clustering dataset
#    (remove Site before k-means)
cluster_dat <- site_means_scaled %>%
  dplyr::select(-Site)

# Optional safety check
sum(is.na(cluster_dat))
sum(!is.finite(as.matrix(cluster_dat)))

# Silhouette check for k = 2:10
set.seed(123)

sil_df <- lapply(2:5, function(k) {
  
  km <- kmeans(
    cluster_dat,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 50
  )
  
  sil <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(cluster_dat))
  
  data.frame(
    k = k,
    mean_silhouette = mean(sil[, 3])
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

sil_df
```

### ii. Clustering

Run k-means using 2 clusters

```{r}
# Fit final k-means model
set.seed(123)

final_k <- 2

km_final <- kmeans(
  cluster_dat,
  centers = final_k,
  nstart = 50
)

# Make a Site-level cluster lookup table

site_clusters <- site_means_scaled %>%
  dplyr::select(Site) %>%
  mutate(Typology2 = factor(km_final$cluster))

site_clusters
```

```{r}
# Join Site-level clusters back to sample-level dat
dat_clustered <- flowing_dat %>%
  left_join(site_clusters, by = "Site")

# Check result
head(dat_clustered)
table(dat_clustered$Typology2, useNA = "ifany")
```

Assign Cluster to samples in dat

```{r}
library(dplyr)

flowing_dat <- flowing_dat %>%
  left_join(site_clusters, by = "Site")

# Check that every sample received a cluster
sum(is.na(flowing_dat$Typology2))

# Look at distribution
table(flowing_dat$Typology2)

# Confirm clusters are consistent by site
flowing_dat %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(n_clusters = n_distinct(Typology2))
```

## 3. Plot of clusters on PCA

Overlay clusters on PCA

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Font sizes
title_size   <- 16
axis_title   <- 16
axis_text    <- 14
legend_title <- 14
legend_text  <- 14
strip_text   <- 14
base_theme <- theme(
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = axis_title),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = axis_title),
  axis.text.x  = element_text(size = axis_text),
  axis.text.y  = element_text(size = axis_text),
  legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = legend_text)
)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 0) Build Site-level table with clusters
#-------------------------------------------------
site_pca_df <- site_means_scaled %>%
  mutate(Typology2 = factor(km_final$cluster))

#-------------------------------------------------
# 1) Force cluster order + set cluster colors
#-------------------------------------------------
typology2_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#56B4E9",
  "2" = "#D55E00"
)
site_pca_df$Typology2 <- 
  factor(site_pca_df$Typology2, levels = c("1", "2"))

#-------------------------------------------------
# 2) Create numeric matrix for PCA
#    (remove Site and Typology2 columns and rename variables)
#-------------------------------------------------
pca_input <- site_pca_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-Site, -Typology2) %>%
  rename(
    Temp = log_Temp_C,
    DOC = log_DOC_uM,
    DIC = log_DIC_uM,
    `Cl-` = log_Cl_uM,
    Ca = log_Ca_uM,
    Mg = log_Mg_uM,
    `SO4 2-` = log_SO4_uM,
    Na = log_Na_uM,
    K = log_K_uM,
    Zn = log_Zn_uM,
    Cu = log_Cu_uM,
    pH = pH
  )
str(pca_input)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 3) Run PCA on Site-level chemistry
#-------------------------------------------------
pca_result <- prcomp(pca_input, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_summary <- summary(pca_result)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 4) Percent variance explained for axis labels
#-------------------------------------------------
pc1_var <- round(pca_summary$importance[2, 1] * 100, 1)
pc2_var <- round(pca_summary$importance[2, 2] * 100, 1)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 5) Rename variables for expression labels
#    (keys must match the renamed pca_input columns)
#-------------------------------------------------
chem_labels2 <- c(
  "Temp"    = "Temp",
  "DOC"     = "DOC",
  "DIC"     = "DIC",
  "Cl-"     = "Cl^{'-'}",
  "Ca"      = "Ca",
  "Mg"      = "Mg",
  "SO4 2-"  = "SO[4]^{'2-'}",
  "Na"      = "Na",
  "K"       = "K",
  "Zn"      = "Zn",
  "Cu"      = "Cu",
  "pH"      = "pH"
)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 6) Build data frames for individuals (sites) and variables
#-------------------------------------------------
ind_df <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:2])
colnames(ind_df) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
ind_df$cluster <- site_pca_df$Typology2

var_df <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation[, 1:2])
colnames(var_df) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
var_df$varname <- rownames(var_df)

scale_factor <- min(
  max(abs(ind_df$PC1)) / max(abs(var_df$PC1)),
  max(abs(ind_df$PC2)) / max(abs(var_df$PC2))
) * 0.8

var_df_scaled <- var_df %>%
  mutate(
    PC1        = PC1 * scale_factor,
    PC2        = PC2 * scale_factor,
    label_expr = chem_labels2[varname],
    nudge_x    = ifelse(varname == "Temp", 1.5, 0),
    nudge_y    = ifelse(varname == "Temp", -1.5, 0)
  )

#-------------------------------------------------
# 7) Build the plot
#-------------------------------------------------
pca_typology2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = ind_df,
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = cluster),
    size = 2, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = var_df_scaled,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = var_df_scaled,
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = label_expr),
    color = "black",
    size = 5,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    force = 5,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size = 0.3,
    nudge_x = var_df_scaled$nudge_x,
    nudge_y = var_df_scaled$nudge_y,
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-6, 12), breaks = seq(-6, 12, by = 6), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-10, 7), breaks = seq(-10, 5, by = 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = typology2_colors, name = "Typology2") +
  
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "%)")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = axis_text) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.8),
    plot.title = element_blank()) +
  base_theme
pca_typology2

#-------------------------------------------------
# 8) Save plot
#-------------------------------------------------
out_dir <- "Clustering by site results"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "PCA_Biplot_Sites_by_Typology2.png"),
  plot     = pca_typology2,
  width    = 8,
  height   = 6,
  dpi      = 300
)
```

## 4. Characterizing clusters

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 1) Define inherent site characteristics
#-------------------------------------------------
site_char <- c("Type", "Regime", "Development")

#-------------------------------------------------
# 2) Make a SITE-LEVEL dataframe
#    Keep one row per Site with its cluster
#-------------------------------------------------
site_level_chars <- 
  flowing_dat %>%
  dplyr::select(Site, all_of(site_char), Typology2) %>%
  distinct()

#-------------------------------------------------
# 3) Count frequencies and compute relative frequency
#    within each Variable x Cluster combination
#-------------------------------------------------
cluster_summary_table_pct <- site_level_chars %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(site_char),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  count(Variable, Typology2, Value, name = "Freq") %>%
  group_by(Variable, Typology2) %>%
  mutate(RelFreq = Freq / sum(Freq) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

cluster_summary_table_pct

# Save
library(openxlsx)

# 1. Create a brand-new workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# 2. Add a sheet
addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = "Typology2")

# 3. Write in the sheet with the dataset
writeData(wb, sheet = "Typology2", cluster_summary_table_pct)

# 4. Save
saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "Relative_freq_by_typology2.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

### Plot

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 1) Define inherent site characteristics
#-------------------------------------------------
site_char <- c("Type", "Regime", "Development")

#-------------------------------------------------
# 2) Make a SITE-LEVEL dataframe
#    Keep one row per Site with its cluster
#-------------------------------------------------
site_level_chars <- 
  flowing_dat %>%
  dplyr::select(Site, all_of(site_char), Typology2) %>%
  distinct()

#-------------------------------------------------
# 3) Count frequencies and compute relative frequency
#    within each Variable x Cluster combination
#-------------------------------------------------
cluster_summary_table_pct <- site_level_chars %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(site_char),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  count(Variable, Typology2, Value, name = "Freq") %>%
  group_by(Variable, Typology2) %>%
  mutate(RelFreq = Freq / sum(Freq) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

#-------------------------------------------------
# 4) Combine variable + value for fill labels
#-------------------------------------------------
cluster_summary_table_pct <- cluster_summary_table_pct %>%
  mutate(Value_labeled = paste0(Variable, ": ", Value))

#-------------------------------------------------
# 5) Set plotting order
#-------------------------------------------------
cluster_summary_table_pct$Value_labeled <- factor(
  cluster_summary_table_pct$Value_labeled,
  levels = c(
    "Type: Tributaries",
    "Type: Main Stem",
    
    "Development: Low",
    "Development: Medium",
    "Development: High",
    
    "Regime: NonPerennial",
    "Regime: Perennial"
  )
)

cluster_summary_table_pct$Variable <- factor(
  cluster_summary_table_pct$Variable,
  levels = c("Type", "Development", "Regime")
)

cluster_summary_table_pct$Typology2 <- factor(
  cluster_summary_table_pct$Typology2,
  levels = c("1", "2")
)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 6) Add cluster name (with n = number of SITES) for plotting
#-------------------------------------------------
cluster_sizes <- site_level_chars %>%
  count(Typology2, name = "n_cluster")

cluster_summary_table_pct <- cluster_summary_table_pct %>%
  left_join(cluster_sizes, by = "Typology2") %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_name = paste0(
      "Cluster ", Typology2,
      " (n=", n_cluster, ")"
    )
  )

#-------------------------------------------------
# 7) Define colors
#-------------------------------------------------
color_map <- c(
  "Type: Tributaries" = "#dadaeb",
  "Type: Main Stem" = "#756bb1",
  
  "Development: Low" = "#fdd49e",
  "Development: Medium" = "orange2",
  "Development: High" = "red3",
  
  "Regime: NonPerennial" = "lightblue",
  "Regime: Perennial" = "#1f78a4"
)

# Legend labels without the variable prefix
legend_labels <- gsub("^.*: ", "", levels(cluster_summary_table_pct$Value_labeled))

#-------------------------------------------------
# 8) Plot relative frequencies by cluster (site-level)
#-------------------------------------------------
rel_freq_site <- ggplot(
  cluster_summary_table_pct,
  aes(y = Variable, x = RelFreq, fill = Value_labeled)
) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    position = "fill",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster_name, ncol = 1, strip.position = "top") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Relative Frequency",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = axis_text) +
  base_theme +                     
  theme(
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(
      angle = 0,
      face = "bold",
      size = strip_text
    ),
    strip.placement  = "outside",
    panel.spacing    = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.box       = "vertical",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      colour = "black"
    )
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = color_map,
    labels = legend_labels
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.8))
rel_freq_site

# Save 
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "Relative_freq_plots_by_site_cluster.png"),
  plot     = rel_freq_site,
  width    = 8,
  height   = 6,
  dpi      = 300
)
```

- Cluster 1: Non-perennial tributary sites with medium-low developed land cover

- Cluster 2: Perennial tributaries and main stem sites with more developed land cover

Identify which Sites fall into each Typology2

```{r}
library(dplyr)

sites_by_typology2 <- flowing_dat %>%
  distinct(Site, Typology2) %>%
  group_by(Typology2) %>%
  summarise(
    Sites = paste(sort(Site), collapse = ", "),
    n_sites = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sites_by_typology2

# Save
library(openxlsx)
```

Rename Typology2

```{r}
flowing_dat <- flowing_dat %>%
  mutate(
    Typology2 = dplyr::recode(
      Typology2,
      `1` = "Non-Perennial",
      `2` = "Perennial Developed"
    )
  )

unique(flowing_dat$Typology2)
```

Add Typology2 to main dataset and label Pooled Water as a Typology

```{r}
# Keep only the columns you need and remove duplicates
typology_lookup <- flowing_dat %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Typology2) %>%
  distinct()

# Join Typology back to dat, and assign unmatched Sample_IDs as Pooled Water
dat <- dat %>%
  left_join(typology_lookup, by = "Sample_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Typology2 = if_else(is.na(Typology2), "Pooled Water", Typology2),
    Typology2 = factor(
      Typology2,
      levels = c("Non-Perennial",
                 "Perennial Developed",
                 "Pooled Water")
    )
  )

# Quick check
unique(dat$Typology2)

# Count samples in each Typology
dat %>%
  count(Typology2)
```

Save

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read in Excel sheet
# --------------------------------------------------
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

file_path <- "C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/Trace-element-bioavailability-spatial-assessment/Zinc/5. Cluster analysis/Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet_Clean3.xlsx"

  dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Typology2) %>%
  distinct()

  count(Sample_ID) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

ha10_dat_updated <- ha10_dat %>%
  left_join(typology_lookup, by = "Sample_ID")

  ha10_dat_updated,
  file = output_path,
  sheetName = sheet_name,
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```
